race.description: Beau South Roof Restorations And Repairs Mdn Plate
race.comment: BOBBIWAA (2) went leading at Grafton and faded the last bit. Has a big jockey switch this time and the longer race has to help. Fitter third-up and sure to give a sight. DYNAMIC DIVA (13) prefers to get back into the field in her races so that can cause issues but she does finish them off. She does look like she wants more ground but is worth consideration. SARMAT (9) had genuine excuses when racing here a fortnight back. His prior form lines could see him place. LOTTERY LINK (6) has run some decent races without looking like winning. The wetter the better for him. In the mix. ENCHANTIC (14) could be ready to show something in her third race run.
